p.s: Although many people say that we will not use cars anymore in the future, yet cars are necessasy tools even in the future.

We benefit from cars very much.
Undeniably, convenient as cars contribute, we can not ignore the negaitve impact they make; say, the exhaust and energy crsis.
However, scientists are now trying to figure out some alternative solutions such as biodiesel.

Since new tecnology has been develpoping in a breathtaking speed, I am optimistic about the futhure.
In my opinion, cars will exsit, maybe changing into another form, but they will always exsit.
